description.value: Hello Toast is a funky, bustling breakfast and lunch spot in downtown Kamloops that has been a community fixture for over 20 years. Run by friends and family, it serves all-day breakfast and house-made lunch plates using locally sourced meats and produce. Cyclists will find a welcoming, casual atmosphere with a sidewalk-side patio and a menu ranging from creative egg dishes to hearty grain bowls.
